title: A road people choose
sub: Platform and solution architecture, a series on the data platform and what is built on it: the platform as a product its users choose, a path already laid from a template, the rules built into it, a guide and someone to ask, no tickets to wait on, and what the platform team counts to know it works.
howto: Technology green is a platform, and blue an application, a data product or a team. A gold tag is an owner in the business. Red is a wait, a ticket or a team that gave up; a green tick, a step done. Amber, a lantern's colour, is the road, its stations, and what every team shares.
